command:
set -euo pipefail
F=$HOME/.local/state/omega-grid-relay/omega_grid_relay_main.py
python3 -m py_compile "$F"
python3 - "$F" <<'PY'
import importlib.util,sys
p=sys.argv[1]; s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('r',p); r=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(r)
base={'effect_id':'probe','organ_id':'host:ai-core-node','task':{'bridge_op':'status','bridge_args':{}},'route':{'selected':'host:ai-core-node'},'authority':'NOT_YET_GRANTED'}
e={**base,'request_sha256':r.digest(base)}
cid,c,op=r.build_local_command(e); b=r.serialized_local_command(c); t=r.ORGAN['host:ai-core-node']
receipt={'schema':'CLAY_LOCAL_RECEIPT/v1','machine_id':'ai-core-node','owner':'gabriel','command_id':cid,'op':op,'command_sha256':r.command_sha256(b),'status':'PASS','exit_code':0,'errors':[]}
assert r.verify_local_receipt(t,c,b,receipt) is receipt
bad=dict(receipt); bad['machine_id']='andreas-maco'
try:r.verify_local_receipt(t,c,b,bad); raise AssertionError('cross-host accepted')
except r.ReceiptVerificationError as x: assert x.code=='RECEIPT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH'
bad=dict(receipt); bad['command_sha256']='0'*64
try:r.verify_local_receipt(t,c,b,bad); raise AssertionError('digest accepted')
except r.ReceiptVerificationError as x: assert x.code=='RECEIPT_COMMAND_DIGEST_MISMATCH'
print('FALSIFIER=PASS')
print('COMMAND_ID='+cid)
PY
